messages:
Jules: Huge thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick non-work check: who’s grabbing the leftover doughnuts in the kitchen? :doughnut: 
Maya Li: I called dibs on the maple ones earlier 🍁 but happy to share. also the tiny harmonica outro deserves a standing ovation :sparkles:
Kevin Park: If anyone's heading to the kitchen, can you snag an extra coffee for me? Need rescue from post-all-hands brain fog ☕
Priya Nair: Video clip of the awkward harmonica solo or it didn't happen. someone gif?
Tom B: https://giphy.com/gifs/awkward-harmonica-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 (boom) :rofl:
Maya Li: omg that GIF is perfect. also who put glitter on the toast during happy hour? I keep finding sparkles in my keyboard :sparkles: :keyboard:
Jules: guilty. i apologize and also do not apologize :grin:
Kevin Park: @Priya Nair can you drop the poll — coffee vs tea vs silent sob?
Priya Nair: quick poll: coffee / tea / nap / more doughnuts. reply with the emoji that matches.
Maya Li: :coffee:
Tom B: :doughnut:
Jules: :nap: but I'd be convinced by a pastry bribe
DeployBot: Recording uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/3345007890 — transcript will be available in ~10min.
Priya Nair: Also — shoutout to the ops team for the mic fix mid-stream, that was iconic. :clap:
Kevin Park: Shoutout accepted. free doughnut for the mic wrangler next week :tada:
Jules: ok team, last thing — virtual confetti for anyone who wants to stick around and jam for 5? :confetti_ball:
Maya Li: I'll bring the kazoo emoji :kazoo: (emoji only performance)
Tom B: I’ll accompany with dramatic sighs and an air harmonica. goodnight y’all ❤️
Jules: Night! and also — the leftover pastries are in the breakroom labeled 'all-hands survivors'. first come first served.
